name: @arena/escalation-observability
description: Arena escalation observability (Work Order C021; issue #127) — the operator-side nervous system of the escalation network. PROJECTIONS ONLY, no domain truth (spec/service-boundaries.md): (1) Lifecycle projections over the C001 event taxonomy — per-escalation timelines with state dwell times, validation-verdict refs, payment-state refs and replacement events, plus per-client-app / per-capability / per-tenant rollups; (2) SLA measurement over the C011 clocks — typed versioned SLA definitions (accept-by / start-by / submit-by / validate-by per urgency class) and measured SLA records derived from C001/C011 events with states met / pending / at-risk / breached-with-reasons; corrections are SUPERSESSIONS (append-only — no retroactive silent edits) and a 'met' record without milestone evidence fails closed; (3) SLO rollups in the A035 vocabulary — aggregate SloEvaluation views per capability / tenant / resource class (C015 routing decisions) with disclosed formulas, sample sizes, explicit small-sample status and cross-tenant detail suppression on aggregate endpoints; (4) operational health signals — matching latency, queue depth, validation backlog, replacement rate, expert availability coverage — typed, dimensional, deterministic given identical event inputs; (5) alert-rule PROJECTIONS mapping breach/at-risk conditions onto the docs/operations/alert-catalog.md closed condition vocabulary (a mapping surface — the catalog itself is not owned). Tenant isolation at the domain level; all timestamps injected (lock rule 17).
